question: Quantify the cost of relaxing count decisions and finite conditional later-charge uncertainty
scope: Pure alpha; fixed95/351ns; full1024x2ns analog voltage; ample dynamic range; original unknownK<=2 count study, separate forcedK2 profiles
data: 280 prior native calibration,760 exposed native and1000 exposed continuous Gaussian evaluation; no new ROOTs, draws or training

threshold.rule: Only alpha changes; fixed caches, per-method calibration, presence, Q>=500 and physical positive-evidence guards remain
threshold.interpretation: Full descriptive sweep; best under observed control limits is retrospective development envelope, not new validated default

profile.inserted: 500, originalQ2 and .5/.8/1/1.2/2 x hybridQ2 clipped to fit domain
profile.time_domain: Both ordered times in [max(0,pilot_t-96),min(2046,pilot_t+512)] ns; pilot from observed K1. Cached out-of-domain candidates flagged, not silently assumed covered.
profile.nuisance: For each fixed later Q2 optimize Q1 and both times; neither true times nor true Q enter primary profiles
profile.optimization: Two best raw starts from cached fits, total-charge adjustment, warm continuation and0/4/8/16/32/64/128/256/512ns gaps;50 L-BFGS-B iterations; forward and reverse passes
profile.envelope: Retain initial values and fixed-nuisance slice in numerical envelope; same candidate-dependent covariance and logdet. No claim of global convergence.
profile.interpretation: Finite compatibility contours, not68/95/99% intervals or posterior probabilities. Keep disjoint segments and truncation flags.
profile.probe: After primary profiles are frozen, fix true later Q2 only in a separately labelled scoring probe, refit nuisance from observed seeds; no probe influences profiles, count gates or default fits
profile.interpolation: LogQ piecewise-linear contour endpoints approximate; actual trueQ probe avoids using interpolation to measure truth inclusion
profile.decision: No default change. Report reference-level truth inclusion, widths, boundary truncation, finite-search errors, and gate-selection conditioning separately.

metrics: Original strict pair Qwithin20%, twithinmin(10ns,gap/4), no extras; missing/extra/split/merge and matched bias/sigma68/time errors retained
literature: Existing local Liddick2012 separate detection and parameter accuracy; Baker/Cousins1984 distinguish point estimation, interval coverage and goodness of fit. No direct Poisson histogram likelihood transplanted to correlated voltage.
